subject.title: feat: add i18n support with zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) locale

question: Should ClawHub keep this issue as a deferred app-localization tracker, close it under the current translation pause, or resume work with a narrowly approved i18n foundation?
rationale: The feature remains absent and has no viable replacement, but the latest member-level direction paused this entire contribution category; automation cannot determine whether that pause is temporary roadmap deferral or durable product policy.

options.title: Keep deferred tracker
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open while declining implementation PRs until maintainers explicitly resume localization work.

options.title: Resume narrow foundation
options.body: Approve a first phase limited to locale-aware metadata, typed keys, parity tests, persistence, and one visible language-switcher slice.

options.title: Close until priorities change
options.body: Close the tracker under the current pause and invite a new proposal only after localization becomes an accepted ClawHub priority.

recommendation.title: Keep deferred tracker
recommendation.body: Leave the canonical issue open while declining implementation PRs until maintainers explicitly resume localization work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the clearest and most recent repository-member product-direction decision for the direct implementation.
